_doc: Mauboussin / Counterpoint Global base rates for sanity checking forecast assumptions. Source: Mauboussin & Callahan 'The Base Rate Book' (Morgan Stanley, multiple updates). Use these to evaluate whether assumed growth rates are realistic.

operating_margin_persistence._units: Probability that top-quintile margin company stays in top quintile
operating_margin_persistence._note: ~65% of top-decile margin businesses lose that position within 10 years

roic_mean_reversion._units: Median ROIC by starting quintile after N years

starting_q5_bottom._note: Bottom quintile reverts UPWARD nearly as reliably as top reverts DOWN — value investing premise

eps_growth_consensus_vs_actual._note: Sell-side 5y consensus EPS growth vs actual

p_e_implied_assumptions._note: Justified P/E (Mauboussin decomposition: P/E = (1 - g/ROIC) / (r - g))

fund_manager_persistence._note: Probability of staying in top quartile

moat_durability._note: Probability a company with ROIC > 15% maintains it for N years

phase_transition_biotech._units: Probability of advancing to next phase / approval

concentration_outcomes._note: Bessembinder 2018 — fraction of net US market gains 1926-2016 from each cohort
concentration_outcomes._implication: Stock picking has lottery-like tail dependence

yfinance_reliability_2026._note: Cross-validate yfinance income statement values vs SEC EDGAR. Bug #2584 active.
yfinance_reliability_2026.shift_direction: typically backward by 1 year for certain line items
yfinance_reliability_2026.mitigation: Use fundamentalsTimeSeries + SEC EDGAR XBRL cross-check

regime_baseline_may_2026.implication: late-cycle / pre-recession; apply -5 macro tilt by default
